description.value: Indian Masala Express is an Indian fine dining restaurant in Squamish offering Northern and Southern Indian cuisine alongside modern Mumbai fusion dishes, all prepared with house-blended herbs and spices. The restaurant operates its own Kismet wine label and offers curated Indian food and wine pairings, which sets it apart from typical Indian restaurants. Cyclists can dine in on the patio or order takeout and Doordash delivery.

address.value: Unit E4-1257 Commercial Way, Squamish, BC V8B 0B2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is a real, operating Indian fine dining restaurant at Unit E4-1257 Commercial Way, Squamish, BC. The site explicitly markets takeout ('One stop Indian Sweets, Snacks, Take Out and Fine Dining with Patio') and Doordash delivery, and features a dedicated vegetarian menu section with numerous vegetarian dishes. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone — both populated from website content.
Website navigation includes a 'COVID-19 Update' link, suggesting the site may not have been updated recently, though all core business content appears current and operational.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Indian fine dining restaurant in Squamish with a verified address, phone, and active website. A useful dining stop for touring cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website features a dedicated VEGETARIAN menu section alongside non-vegetarian; items include Vegetable Samosa, Veggie Pakora, Paneer Tikka, Vegetable Manchurian, and more. No explicit vegan or GF claims found
